# native

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Native OS notifications from the menu-bar panel: the Notifications switch (MenuBar.Section 'notifications', a config_v2 bool, off by default), shown only when the helper can notify, and a MenuBar.Mount that — while the switch is on — hands every notification that arrives (shell/notifications' useNotificationArrivals: live, never the ones already there) to the helper's notify. Registers the native-notifications config (enabled, off by default) so the menu-bar panel's switch persists.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `ConfigV2.WebRegister` "config"
    - `MenuBar.Section` "Notifications" → `NativeNotificationsSwitch`
    - `MenuBar.Mount` "native-notifications" → `NativeNotificationsForwarder`
  - Uses:
    - `config_v2.ConfigV2`
    - `config_v2.useConfig`
    - `config_v2.useSetConfig`
    - `menu-bar.MenuBar`
    - `menu-bar.useNativeHost`
    - `primitives/css/fill.Fill`
    - `primitives/css/row.Row`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/switch.SwitchIndicator`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
    - `primitives/css/ui-kit.Separator`
    - `shell/notifications.useNotificationArrivals`
    - `ui/icons.Icon`
- Server:
  - Contributes: `ConfigV2.Register` "config"
  - Uses: `config_v2.ConfigV2`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens: `ui/tokens/color-palette --muted-foreground`
